Title: Fraud Prevention Strategy Lead _ Openbank México
Description: Country: Mexico Descripción de puesto ES EL MOMENTO Santander (www.santander.com) está evolucionando de ser una marca global de alto impacto a una organización impulsada por la tecnología , y las personas están en el centro de este camino. Juntos, estamos liderando una transformación centrada en el cliente que valora el pensamiento disruptivo , la valentía de desafiar lo posible y la capacidad de innovar . Esto es más que un cambio estratégico: es una oportunidad para crecer, aprender y generar un impacto real . Nuestra misión es contribuir a que más personas y empresas prosperen . Adoptamos una sólida cultura de riesgos y esperamos que todos nuestros equipos asuman un enfoque proactivo y responsable en la gestión del riesgo. EL IMPACTO QUE GENERARÁS Openbank México está buscando un Fraud Prevention Strategy Lead para diseñar e implementar estrategias de prevención de fraude digital en sus productos y canales, mediante el uso de analítica avanzada, monitoreo transaccional y modelos de detección, con el objetivo de minimizar las pérdidas operativas por fraude sin comprometer la experiencia del cliente. La posición será responsable de desarrollar políticas y estrategias antifraude, diseñar y optimizar motores de decisión y reglas de detección, analizar patrones transaccionales y coordinar la respuesta ante eventos sospechosos. Asimismo, impulsará iniciativas de mejora continua mediante pruebas A/B, backtesting y modelos predictivos, asegurando el cumplimiento normativo y la protección de los activos del banco. Los siguientes requisitos representan los conocimientos, habilidades y competencias esenciales para este puesto. Experiencia profesional 5 a 8 años de experiencia en gestión y prevención de fraude en banca digital, fintech o instituciones financieras. Experiencia en el diseño e implementación de estrategias de prevención de fraude digital, utilizando análisis de datos, segmentación de riesgos y monitoreo transaccional. Experiencia en el desarrollo, configuración y optimización de motores de decisión y reglas antifraude, utilizando plataformas especializadas. Experiencia en identificación y análisis de patrones de fraude, evaluación de alertas y detección de comportamientos transaccionales sospechosos. Experiencia implementando estrategias de mejora continua mediante pruebas A/B, backtesting de reglas y modelos predictivos. Educación Licenciatura en Ingeniería, Matemáticas Aplicadas, Ciencias Computacionales, Actuaría, Criminología o áreas afines. Deseables certificaciones en prevención de fraude (CFE/ACFE), Data Analytics o ciberfraude. Habilidades técnicas: Conocimiento profundo de esquemas de fraude digital, incluyendo phishing, account takeover, card-not-present y SIM swap. Experiencia con plataformas especializadas de prevención de fraude como Feedzai, Actimize, SAS Fraud o similares. Diseño, implementación y optimización de motores de reglas antifraude y sistemas de monitoreo transaccional en tiempo real. Capacidad para analizar grandes volúmenes de información transaccional, identificar patrones sospechosos y generar insights para la toma de decisiones. Conocimiento de modelos predictivos, segmentación de riesgos, pruebas A/B y backtesting para mejorar la precisión de detección de fraude. Experiencia en monitoreo y análisis de alertas operativas, así como en la definición y ajuste de umbrales de detección. Familiaridad con la normativa aplicable en materia de PLD/FT, ciberseguridad y disposiciones de la CNBV. Capacidad para identificar tendencias emergentes de fraude y evaluar tecnologías antifraude dentro del ecosistema bancario y fintech. Conocimiento de procesos de prevención de fraude orientados a equilibrar la mitigación del riesgo y la experiencia del cliente. Habilidades interpersonales : Pensamiento analítico para identificar patrones de fraude, interpretar información transaccional y desarrollar estrategias de prevención. Capacidad para resolver problemas y tomar decisiones basadas en datos, considerando el impacto en el riesgo operativo y la experiencia del cliente. Capacidad de colaboración transversal. VALORAMOS TU IMPACTO Tu contribución importa, y la reconocemos. En Openbank puedes esperar un paquete retributivo justo y competitivo que refleje tu impacto y el valor que entregarás. Toma un momento para entender a lo que nos referimos: Ofrecemos más que un salario: nuestros beneficios están diseñados para apoyar tu vida, tus objetivos y tu bienestar, hoy y en el futuro Tu salud es nuestra prioridad. A través de BeHealthy, nuestro programa global de bienestar, promovemos el bienestar integral de nuestros equipos Sabemos que la familia es lo más importante. Por eso ofrecemos apoyo en el cuidado de hijos y programas familiares adaptados a cada etapa de la vida Impulsamos a nuestros equipos a ir más allá mediante oportunidades de crecimiento, movilidad internacional y amplias trayectorias de carrera Creemos en el poder de ayudar: puedes dedicar parte de tu jornada laboral al voluntariado Estamos aquí para mantener tu motivación , ayudarte a alcanzar tus metas y celebrar tus logros en cada paso del camino. Openbank es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Todas las candidaturas serán consideradas en igualdad de condiciones, sin distinción por identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico, religión, edad, orientación política, afiliación sindical o situación de discapacidad. Tomamos nuestras decisiones de contratación con base en tu experiencia y habilidades. Valoramos tu pasión por descubrir, crear, simplificar y construir.

Title: Sr. AI/ML Engineer (MXC)
Description: Do work that matters. At AlertMedia , we help organizations protect their people, operations, and brand. Our modern Risk Intelligence and Response platform empowers teams to detect emerging threats, assess impact, and respond with confidence. We believe building resilience should be simpler—and it starts with bringing critical information and workflows together in one unified platform. Our core values drive us in our important mission of keeping people safe & informed: We’re humans not robots Customers always come first We work better together Simplicity is our strength Our reputation is priceless Hard work pays off AlertMedia is looking for an innovative and hands-on Sr. AI/ML Engineer with a strong background in applied machine learning and data science to lead the evaluation, training, and integration of advanced AI and machine learning models across our product suite. You will have the opportunity to show who you are throughout our interview process; we don’t ask any trick questions or expect you to perform a whiteboard exercise. Lead prompt engineering and testing efforts to fine-tune LLM behavior for specific use cases across the product suite. Proactively identify opportunities to improve AI models, data pipelines, and engineering workflows beyond the existing roadmap. Contribute to AlertMedia’s culture, values and vision for the future. Strong understanding of LLMs and traditional machine learning methods. Experience with prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, and evaluation. Familiarity with model evaluation best practices, including offline metrics, cross-validation, and A/B testing. Proficiency in Python and ML libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face). Experience working with Elasticsearch or other large-scale search and indexing platforms. Experience with cloud-based ML tooling (e.g., SageMaker, Bedrock) and data workflows. Demonstrated experience training and deploying supervised learning models, ideally in production environments (a plus). Ability to work independently and collaboratively on cross-functional teams. Title: IDB Invest - Development Effectiveness Consultant

Support the production of knowledge products focused on development effectiveness. Title: Director, Vaccines Real-World Evidence Scientist / Epidemiologist
Description: Role Summary The Director, Vaccines Real-World Evidence Scientist / Epidemiologist, will assume a scientific leadership role within the Vaccines Real-World Evidence and Epidemiology organization, supporting global evidence generation for maternal immunization. The Director will lead real-world evidence (RWE) and epidemiologic studies designed to address important evidence needs related to maternal vaccines, including vaccine effectiveness, vaccine impact, maternal and infant disease burden, and other questions relevant to vaccine policy and utilization. Evidence generated through these studies will support scientific and medical decision-making and external dissemination through peer-reviewed publications and scientific congresses. The position requires strong expertise in epidemiologic methods and experience designing and executing complex observational research. Studies may include prospective field epidemiology studies as well as studies using large real-world data sources such as electronic health records, administrative claims, registries, and other routinely collected health data. The Director will work in a highly matrixed, global environment and collaborate closely with colleagues across RWE, Medical, Biostatistics, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Safety, Data Sciences & Analytics, and other functions, as well as external investigators and research partners. Main Responsibilities Lead RWE and Epidemiologic Studies Independently lead complex observational and epidemiologic studies addressing maternal immunization evidence needs, including vaccine effectiveness, impact, and vaccine-preventable disease burden. Lead studies across the full research lifecycle, from development of the research question and study concept through protocol and statistical analysis plan development, study implementation, analysis, interpretation, and dissemination. Lead studies using large real-world databases, including electronic health records, administrative claims, registries, and other health data sources, as well as prospective field epidemiology studies. Provide scientific leadership for study protocols, statistical analysis plans, data collection approaches, and interpretation of study results. Ensure that study designs and methods are scientifically rigorous and appropriate to the research question and intended use of the evidence. Provide Epidemiologic and Scientific Leadership Serve as an epidemiologic subject-matter expert for maternal immunization RWE and contribute to the development of evidence-generation strategies. Identify important evidence gaps and translate them into feasible, scientifically rigorous RWE research questions. Provide guidance on appropriate study designs, data sources, endpoints, methods, and analytic approaches. Critically evaluate study results, including potential sources of bias, confounding, misclassification, and uncertainty, and ensure appropriate interpretation of findings. Provide scientific input to feasibility assessments and selection of appropriate internal and external real-world data sources. Lead Scientific Collaborations and Study Execution Lead scientific interactions with external investigators, academic collaborators, research networks, data partners, and vendors. Coordinate cross-functional study teams to support timely and high-quality execution of RWE studies. Provide scientific oversight of study deliverables and resolve methodological or scientific issues that arise during study execution. Support evaluation of external research and data partnerships, including scientific feasibility and suitability for addressing evidence needs. Manage complex projects independently and maintain accountability for study milestones and deliverables. Generate and Disseminate Evidence Lead the scientific interpretation and communication of RWE study findings. Lead or contribute to peer-reviewed manuscripts, conference abstracts, scientific presentations, study reports, and other evidence-generation deliverables. Present and communicate study findings to internal and external scientific audiences. Translate complex epidemiologic findings into clear scientific insights relevant to maternal immunization evidence needs. Collaborate Across the Maternal Immunization Program Partner with Global Medical and other cross-functional colleagues to ensure RWE studies address important scientific and evidence-generation priorities. Contribute epidemiologic expertise to broader maternal immunization scientific strategy and evidence-generation activities. Collaborate across countries and regions to develop evidence that is relevant to diverse healthcare systems and maternal immunization programs. Provide scientific leadership across multiple concurrent studies and research collaborations. Required Qualifications Master's degree in epidemiology, pharmacoepidemiology, public health with a substantial epidemiology concentration, or a closely related discipline. Substantial relevant experience in epidemiology, RWE, vaccines, infectious diseases, perinatal epidemiology, public health, academia, or the pharmaceutical industry. Demonstrated experience independently designing, leading, and completing complex observational epidemiologic studies. Strong expertise in epidemiologic and statistical methods applicable to observational and non-interventional research. Demonstrated ability to lead projects from development of the research question through protocol development, analysis, interpretation, and scientific dissemination. Experience working with real-world data sources and/or conducting field epidemiology or prospective observational studies. Demonstrated ability to work effectively in global, cross-functional, highly matrixed teams. Strong scientific communication skills, including demonstrated ability to communicate complex epidemiologic concepts clearly in writing and presentations. Demonstrated project leadership and ability to manage multiple complex research activities. Fluency in written and spoken English. Preferred Qualifications PhD, DrPH, ScD, or equivalent doctoral degree in epidemiology, pharmacoepidemiology, public health, or a closely related discipline. Experience in vaccine epidemiology, maternal immunization, infectious diseases, respiratory diseases, perinatal epidemiology, or related areas. Experience conducting vaccine effectiveness, vaccine impact, or vaccine-preventable disease burden studies. Experience with prospective field studies, surveillance systems, or multisite epidemiologic research. Experience with large healthcare databases, electronic health records, administrative claims, registries, or linked health data. Experience working with external investigators and international research collaborations. Understanding of the use of RWE in regulatory, medical, and vaccine policy settings. Description: Scope This position is a global role in real-world evidence (RWE) and epidemiology within the Pneumococcal Vaccines team, Integrated Evidence Generation / Vaccines group. Author and review study protocols, reports, presentations (internally and at scientific conferences), and peer-reviewed manuscripts. Oversee analyses of real-world data, such as large healthcare or claims databases, to address evidence needs related to pneumococcal disease and vaccines. Provide input to all aspects of study design (e.g., methodology, protocols, analytic plans) Provide scientific leadership for assigned RWE and epidemiology studies and be accountable for the scientific quality and timely delivery of study outputs. Establish and maintain relationships with internal and external collaborators Work with internal and external experts in statistics and data analysis to analyze and interpret data from burden of disease and vaccine studies. Qualifications PhD in Epidemiology or a related discipline or MD and + 3 years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical, academic and/or medical or public health environments; or MPH or another relevant Master's degree + 5 years of relevant experience as previously stated Subject matter expertise in infectious disease epidemiology. Strong epidemiological and statistical methods skills used in observational and non-interventional studies. Experience in infectious-disease epidemiology and/or vaccinology, including research, clinical development, epidemiologic studies, or infectious-disease surveillance. Prior experience conducting analyses of real-world data, for example using large databases from health care systems containing ICD-10 codes or claims data preferred. Strong technical expertise, analytic ability, creative problem-solving, and communication skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills including scientific writing skills as evidenced by authorship on peer-reviewed publications in English. Strong interpersonal skills. Strong work ethic and track record of delivering high-quality results within timelines. Able to review, evaluate, interpret, and present complex data. Title: Arquitecto de IA
Description: Job Description: Arquitecto de IA (AI Architect) Objetivo del puesto Diseñar y definir la arquitectura técnica de soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial y Machine Learning, traduciendo los requerimientos del negocio en componentes tecnológicos específicos, escalables, seguros y eficientes. Será responsable de determinar los servicios, componentes de software, infraestructura, integraciones y flujos de datos necesarios para implementar cada solución, asegurando su viabilidad técnica y alineación con los objetivos del negocio. Responsabilidades principales Diseñar arquitecturas técnicas para soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial, Machine Learning y plataformas de datos. Traducir los requerimientos funcionales y necesidades del negocio en diseños de arquitectura, componentes de software e infraestructura. Definir la arquitectura de datos, incluyendo modelos de datos, flujos de información, almacenamiento, procesamiento e integración entre sistemas. Diseñar e implementar estrategias de integración mediante APIs, microservicios y servicios de nube. Evaluar y seleccionar servicios de AWS para soportar soluciones de IA, procesamiento de datos y despliegue de modelos. Definir patrones de diseño, estándares técnicos y buenas prácticas para garantizar la escalabilidad, disponibilidad, seguridad y mantenibilidad de las soluciones. Diseñar mecanismos de orquestación de datos y servicios, asegurando la interoperabilidad entre los diferentes componentes tecnológicos. Colaborar con equipos de desarrollo, Data Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning y áreas de negocio para garantizar la correcta implementación de la arquitectura. Identificar riesgos técnicos, dependencias, limitaciones de infraestructura y oportunidades de optimización durante el diseño de las soluciones. Estimar los componentes, servicios y recursos tecnológicos necesarios para la implementación de cada caso de uso. Documentar diagramas de arquitectura, decisiones técnicas, especificaciones de integración y lineamientos de implementación. Participar activamente en la definición técnica de los casos de uso, manteniendo una participación acorde con la demanda y complejidad de los proyectos. Requisitos indispensables Experiencia sólida en diseño de arquitectura de soluciones tecnológicas, arquitectura de datos y plataformas de IA/ML. Experiencia diseñando soluciones que integren múltiples componentes de software, servicios de nube y fuentes de datos. Conocimientos sólidos de arquitectura de datos, modelado de datos y diseño de flujos de información. Experiencia en diseño e integración de APIs, servicios web y arquitecturas basadas en microservicios. Experiencia en plataformas cloud, preferentemente AWS. Conocimiento de patrones de arquitectura, principios de diseño de software y buenas prácticas de integración. Experiencia en orquestación de procesos, servicios o flujos de datos. Capacidad para convertir requerimientos de negocio en especificaciones técnicas, diagramas de arquitectura y planes de implementación. Habilidad para comunicar decisiones arquitectónicas y colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios. Conocimientos técnicos deseables Servicios de AWS relacionados con datos, analítica e Inteligencia Artificial, como Amazon S3, AWS Lambda, AWS Glue, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock y servicios de integración. Arquitecturas cloud-native, serverless y basadas en microservicios. Integración de modelos de Machine Learning y soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial generativa. Diseño de pipelines de datos y arquitecturas ETL/ELT. Herramientas de orquestación y automatización de procesos. Conocimientos de seguridad, gobierno de datos, observabilidad y optimización de costos en la nube. Experiencia con soluciones escalables y ambientes productivos de IA/ML.

Title: Senior Centralized Monitoring Analyst- CM Lead

Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthroughs.

Title: Senior .Net Developer Ai
Description: About Delinea Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure. Senior Software Engineer, Iris AI About The Iris AI Team Iris AI powers the AI-driven capabilities of the Delinea Platform, tackling real-world security challenges. Our team leverages LLMs to detect anomalies in audit data, enhance authorization decisions, and deploy intelligent agents that deliver tangible results for our customers. The work is innovative, fast-paced, and directly impacts some of the world’s largest organizations. The Role As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll design, build, and operate the cloud services that drive Delinea's AI features. LLMs are a core part of your toolkit: from inference and retrieval to agents and evaluation, you’ll take ownership across the product surface. Our services are developed in C#/.NET, Python, and Go—strength in any is valued, and openness to learn others is expected. You’ll report to the Director of Engineering, Iris AI This position is in a Hybrid Model in Mexico city . What You'll Do Build and operate scalable, highly available backend services in C#/.NET, Python, and Go, utilizing Azure and Kubernetes. Develop LLM-powered features using platforms such as Azure AI Foundry: model integration, context pipelines, RAG, tool calling, agents, and evaluation. Design event-driven, asynchronous architectures across microservices. Take end-to-end responsibility for delivery, including infrastructure-as-code with Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and production incident response. Collaborate with product, UX, and other platform teams; actively participate in code and design reviews. Leverage AI in your daily workflow; use coding agents to design, write, and review code held to the same standard as hand-written code. What You'll Need Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience. 8+ years of experience designing and building production backend services in C#/.NET, Python, or Go, and engaging across the full software development lifecycle. Hands-on experience building products with LLMs, including inference, structured outputs, RAG, tool calling, or agents (e.g., Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Anthropic API, or similar). Proficiency with AI-assisted development (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor), with emphasis on spec-driven development, careful context management, and verified, tested output. Strong understanding of distributed systems, API design, and microservices, as well as experience with a major cloud provider. Sound knowledge of multi-tenant SaaS architecture and the challenges of operating at scale. Bonus Points Experience building tools, APIs, or integrations that AI agents call (e.g., MCP servers, function/tool-calling interfaces, plugins). Depth in ML and MLOps: fine-tuning, evaluation harnesses, and model deployment in production. Expertise in Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines. Background in identity security, PAM, or Zero Trust architectures. Why work at Delinea? We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities. We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative. What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression. At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success: Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team Ownership - We take initiative and follow through Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie. We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays. Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Upon conditional offer of employment, candidates are required to complete comprehensive criminal background check, verification of education, and verification of employment, per employment policy. Title: Strategy & Ops Analyst
Description: En Homie estamos transformando la forma en que las personas rentan vivienda en LATAM. Combinamos tecnología, operación y servicio para construir una experiencia de renta más rápida, transparente y sin fricciones para propietarios e inquilinos. Implementar modelos de lenguaje (LLMs) y prompts optimizados en flujos operativos para automatizar tareas complejas de procesamiento de datos y comunicación. Analizar y optimizar procesos de negocio identificando cuellos de botella y oportunidades de automatización de alto impacto. Monitorear y auditar la ejecución de los flujos automáticos en producción para asegurar su estabilidad, robustez y correcta gestión de errores. Generar reportes y métricas operativas a partir del análisis de datos obtenidos de los flujos y sistemas integrados. Documentar técnicamente los flujos construidos, las arquitecturas no-code implementadas y las guías de uso operativo. Lo que necesitas para aplicar Experiencia demostrable creando y manteniendo automatizaciones y flujos en producción con Make o n8n. Conocimiento práctico en la integración y uso de la WhatsApp Cloud API y webhooks. Experiencia aplicando LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) y Prompt Engineering en escenarios reales de negocio. Sólida capacidad analítica, pensamiento estructurado y mentalidad orientada a la resolución de problemas. Habilidad para trabajar en entornos dinámicos y adaptar soluciones ante cambios en requerimientos operativos. Suma mucho si tienes Conocimientos básicos o intermedios en lenguajes de programación (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript) y consultas SQL. Experiencia previa en el sector Proptech, Fintech o startups de alto crecimiento. Manejo de herramientas de bases de datos (Airtable, PostgreSQL) o integración de APIs RESTful. Colaboración interna Trabajará estrechamente con los equipos de Operaciones, Producto y Tecnología para mapear requerimientos y traducir necesidades operativas en automatizaciones escalables. Colaborará con los líderes de área para monitorear la adopción de los nuevos flujos y optimizar continuamente el desempeño de las herramientas implementadas. Servirá como puente entre la estrategia analítica y la ejecución técnica operativa mediante soluciones no-code y LLMs. En Homie creemos que los mejores equipos se construyen con perspectivas distintas. Valoramos la diversidad de experiencias, formas de pensar, trayectorias, identidades y contextos, porque sabemos que eso nos ayuda a tomar mejores decisiones y construir soluciones más completas. Buscamos crear un entorno donde cada persona pueda aportar con libertad, aprender, retarse y crecer.
